contract.supervisor: LTC2962 H-grade, VCC2.25–5.5V, DVCC grounded for open-drain
contract.isolator_default: LOW with F suffix; input ≤1.7V/output ≥2.25V; 1.7–2.25V is undetermined

open_gates: Actual MOTOR_5V_A/B supplies, protection and source current budget are absent; CORE_5V4.85V lower bound has no guaranteed downstream loss headroom.
FIELD_5V generation and actual AUX_5V/AUX_24V independent bank limiters, current limits, output drop/distribution and sustained-short survival must be implemented.
AUX24 inherited18–30V requirement is preserved;19–29V is only the guaranteed static acceptance screen for these thresholds, not equivalent full-range qualification.
LTC2962 comparator40us maximum is specified at10% overdrive; no maximum for arbitrarily shallow faults or all brownout slopes.
LTC2962 power-down reset state is guaranteed only down to VCC1V; exact0V leakage and powered valid operation are separate from intermediate rails.
ISO7720F output is undetermined with receiving power absent or supply1.7–2.25V; defaultLOW is not a proof of all intermediate-power transitions.
No hard power cut independent of partially powered3.3V logic is fitted by this monitoring-only block; parent power sequencing/withdrawal slope and LED rail transitions require physical validation.
Supply overvoltage monitoring is delayed fault signalling, not a surge clamp.
Precision resistor exact orderability, lifetime drift, soldering stress and source impedance/noise require sourcing and qualification.
Board layout must preserve FIELD_GND/LOGIC_GND isolation and Kelvin sense references, with actual contact/copper/drop and domain-entry assignment verified.
